## History

God is a central religious figure whose existence and teachings shape the lives and spiritual practices of the residents of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns to address God through prayer, later helping young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) navigate his own moral dilemma regarding saying his bedtime prayers. Additionally, God serves as a subject of discussion among the community, as characters such as Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) express strong opinions on church denominations and how different groups view Him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P3](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VII.
